title: Projects, Modules, and Source Sets Quick Check

questions.prompt: Which module type produces an installable Android application?
questions.explanation: The Android application plugin packages the installable artifact and application identity.

questions.prompt: Match each source set to its role.
questions.explanation: Source-set names determine which variant or test compilation receives their files.

questions.prompt: A Gradle module dependency graph can safely contain circular project dependencies.
questions.explanation: Build modules require an acyclic dependency order; shared contracts should be extracted or coordination moved upward.
